bio: Enjoy a tour of Morgan Motor Company's factory in Malvern and witness a car being made from start to finish.  Treat a motoring enthusiast to a unique behind-the-scenes tour of the Morgan Motor Company and its factory. With more than 100 years' experience making quality sports cars, they are experts in their field. After an introductory film, you’ll each be given an audio system that will enable you to hear the tour guide throughout the factory. Head into all the workshops and witness a sports car being made by hand from start to finish. This two-hour tour will end at the museum, which you can explore before tucking into a delicious Afternoon Tea for two. Delight in a scrumptious selection of finger sandwiches, scones with whipped cream and jam, cupcakes and a choice of tea, coffee or herbal infusions.
